text: {"lessons":["Watching my account fall from 97,278 to 75,678 without trading shows that doing nothing is also a choice; I should review whether each holding still fits my plan.","I should set clear, risk-based rules for position sizes and when to sell, and follow them even when a loss feels hard to acknowledge.","Since past price movements do not predict future ones, I should base each decision on my current portfolio and objectives, not on trying to recover losses or chase a rebound."]}
